ctx.x: Because Milt Hinton sent me a thick thing, you know, and every time he would mark it in the red -- I was reading through it and he would put a red pencil note and say, 'This is your teacher.' Well, Dr. Anderson, you know? Oh, he taught me counterpoint, and oh, he's a massive musician. And I don't know whether he's still there or not, but he's been there for years. He went from Kentucky State to I think it was either Oberlin or Antioch, in Ohio, you know?
